topic: Discrepancy in impression counting for frames
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on a discrepancy in how impressions are counted for certain digital frames (specifically CC Brazil). The issue is that while the content appears as static on the production environment but pulls from inventory as digital on staging, the impression count seems to be calculated using a digital screen model (dividing by the number of slots) when viewing the data dashboard, even though the query suggests it should be treated as a static screen.

[me] suggested that this discrepancy might be due to a front-end glitch or caching issue, rather than an error in the core logic.
decisions: The underlying cause of the impression counting discrepancy is suspected to be a front-end/caching issue.
